Yadias is the University of Luxembourg's online application portal for bachelor's, master's and doctoral admissions. Because Luxembourg's tuition is low and doctoral positions are salaried, the practical financial question is admission itself — programme-specific deadlines appear inside Yadias as you select your study programme.

Programme Highlights

  • Single portal for all University of Luxembourg admissions
  • Salaried doctoral positions across its research centres
  • Low tuition with fee-waiver and grant options
  • Multilingual campus at the heart of EU institutions

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's graduates targeting Luxembourg master's programmes and PhD candidates applying to advertised doctoral positions.

Funding and Costs

Luxembourg's low tuition plus university fee waivers and government grants where eligible; PhD positions are salaried. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Create a Yadias account, select your programme, and follow the deadline and document list shown for your intake. Key deadline information: Portal open per intake — programme deadlines appear inside Yadias when you apply.
